description: This file contains a unit test class 'VacancyDaoTest' for testing the 'VacancyDao' data access object within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It tests CRUD operations and filtering functionalities related to vacancy management.

classes.name: VacancyDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for the VacancyDao class, testing vacancy CRUD operations and filtering based on search parameters.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates VacancyDao instance, and populates test data from fixture YAML file.

methods.name: testSaveVacancy
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a vacancy entity.

methods.name: testGetVacancyById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a vacancy by its ID.

methods.name: testUpdateVacancy
methods.description: Tests updating an existing vacancy and confirming changes.

methods.name: testDeleteVacancies
methods.description: Tests deletion of vacancies and confirms they are no longer retrievable.

methods.name: testGetVacancies
methods.description: Tests getting a list of vacancies without filters.

methods.name: testGetVacanciesFilterByJobTitle
methods.description: Tests filtering vacancies by job title ID.

methods.name: testGetVacanciesFilterByVacancyId
methods.description: Tests filtering vacancies by specific vacancy IDs.

methods.name: testGetVacanciesFilterByHiringMangerId
methods.description: Tests filtering vacancies by hiring manager employee number.

methods.name: testGetVacanciesFilterByStatus
methods.description: Tests filtering vacancies by status flag.

methods.name: testGetVacancyListGroupByHiringManager
methods.description: Tests retrieving vacancies grouped by hiring manager.

methods.name: testSearchVacanciesCount
methods.description: Tests counting vacancies based on filters.
